review_scope: Adversarial portable source review of exact copied runtime draft using Go overlay; no candidate/canonical writes or GUI.

check.scope: Three assertions fail against initial copied draft; this is historical RED evidence, not current candidate acceptance.

findings.description: Direct indexed bounds only check offsets. With [0,100,50,300], JumpToKey row2 accepts its offset50 even RowAt(50) is row0, producing active identity and viewport anchor disagreement.
findings.minimal_fix: For each accessed direct row, validate metrics.RowAt(start) and metrics.RowAt(end-1) equal that row; avoid recursive at/bounds calls.

findings.description: The same unchecked direct row span permits Page(+1) from row2 to accept overlapping lower row0 rather than refuse invalid source geometry. Test isolates Page with internal active origin; first finding also shows this origin can be produced through public JumpToKey before correction.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate accessed direct-row inverses; navigation must refuse contradictory metrics rather than accept opposite index motion.

findings.description: After accepting source revision2 while bad row2 is hidden, SetViewport Height45 accepts malformed interior span [20,15] because layout validates only visible endpoints. Snapshot then fails after viewport/generation already committed.
findings.minimal_fix: After capacity admission, validate all bounded visible/overscan row spans before committing a geometry transition. No hidden-source scan is required.

limitations: The source is borrowed and must be immutable within revision; no complete validation of hidden boundaries is expected.
This tests observed malformed metrics and atomic geometry refusal, not concurrency on one owner-confined Grid.
